description: This file contains SQL functions and trigger definitions for automatic timestamp updates on specific tables, as well as a helper RPC to create organizations with owners atomically within a PostgreSQL database using PL/pgSQL.

methods.name: public.handle_updated_at
methods.description: Function to automatically update the 'updated_at' timestamp for a row before update.

methods.name: public.create_org_with_owner
methods.description: A helper function to create an organization and add the creator as an owner atomically.
